chapter.headline: Write chapter by chapter
chapter.subtitle: Every great book is built one chapter at a time. BloomScript Novels Scripts Comic Production gives each chapter guided writing prompts — scene, character, dialogue, and more — so you always know what to write next.

characters.headline: Build your cast of characters
characters.subtitle: Add characters with their name, role, traits, and backstory. BloomScript Novels Scripts Comic Production weaves them into your chapter prompts and AI drafts automatically — your protagonist drives every scene.

ai.headline: AI writes your first draft
ai.subtitle: Stuck on a section? Let AI generate a first draft based on your prompts, characters, and story so far. Edit it, keep it, or use it as a spark — the words are yours to shape.

followup.headline: Go deeper with AI questions
followup.subtitle: Once you've written a section, tap the follow-up button and AI asks you a thought-provoking question to push the scene further. Great writing lives in the details.

thesaurus.headline: Find the perfect word
thesaurus.subtitle: Tap the Thesaurus button while editing any paragraph. Select a word — or just place your cursor — and instantly browse synonyms grouped by part of speech. Tap one to replace it in place.

grammar.headline: Check grammar & dialogue
grammar.subtitle: One tap repairs run-on sentences, fixes punctuation inside speech marks, and catches misplaced commas throughout your chapter. Your dialogue sounds sharp. Your prose reads clean.

covers.headline: AI-generated book covers
covers.subtitle: Give your book a face. Describe a cover concept and BloomScript Novels Scripts Comic Production generates a professional image in seconds. Apply it to your book with one tap.

manuscript.headline: Import your manuscript
manuscript.subtitle: Already written? Import a PDF, DOCX, or TXT file and BloomScript detects your chapter structure automatically — splitting your book into editable chapters in seconds. Pick up where you left off.

folders.headline: Organise your library
folders.subtitle: Create folders to group your books by series, project, or genre. Drag books between folders and keep your library as tidy — or as sprawling — as your imagination.

preview.headline: Preview your whole book
preview.subtitle: See every chapter and section assembled into one seamless read. Scroll through your entire manuscript, spot gaps, and feel the flow before you share it with anyone.

share.headline: Share your manuscript
share.subtitle: When you're ready, export your full book as text or PDF in one tap. Send it to your editor, share it with beta readers, or save it for yourself. Your story, out in the world.

print.headline: Print your book
print.subtitle: Format your manuscript for print — choose fonts, margins, chapter title alignment, and page number style. Export a print-ready PDF and send it straight to a printer or self-publishing platform.

comic.headline: Build your comic book
comic.subtitle: Turn any chapter scene into a comic panel in seconds. Choose your style — Manga, Noir, Ligne Claire, Superhero, or Indie — and AI directs the camera angle, perspective, pose, and composition for you. Tap Panel from any chapter to start.

screenplay.headline: Write your screenplay
screenplay.subtitle: Turn your story into a short film, feature, or stage play. The Screenplay Wizard analyses your book, maps a beat-by-beat plot structure, then writes each scene in proper script format — action lines, dialogue, and all.

illustrate.headline: Illustrate your book
illustrate.subtitle: Give every chapter a hand-crafted illustration. Describe the scene and BloomScript generates a full-page image in your chosen art style — watercolour, ink sketch, digital painting, or fantasy art. Drop it straight into your book.

pro.headline: Unlock BloomScript Pro
pro.subtitle: Upgrade to Pro for unlimited AI chapter drafts, AI-generated book covers, screenplay conversion, illustrated chapters, and everything BloomScript has to offer. Your story deserves the full toolkit.
